Guideline: Use the m3 theme of the Bun Tailwind plugin
Description: @aphrody/bun-plugin-tailwind with theme m3 inserts m3-tokens.css, expressive.css, the m3-tailwind preset and a seeded colour scheme right after @import tailwindcss
Do: Enable theme: "m3" on the Bun.build plugin or the bunfig [serve.static] plugin
Don't: Copy --md-sys-color-* values by hand into a global stylesheet

Guideline: Use the PostCSS entry for Next.js and Vite
Description: The PostCSS plugin runs the same engine and options as the Bun plugin so Turbopack, webpack and Vite builds get the same M3 output
Do: Register @aphrody/bun-plugin-tailwind/postcss in postcss.config.mjs
Don't: Stack @tailwindcss/postcss next to the Aphrody plugin

Guideline: Seed the scheme with the brand colour
Description: The m3 theme defaults to the baseline seed #6750A4; a branded product passes its own seed variant and contrast level
Do: Pass theme: { seed, variant, contrastLevel } for branded apps
Don't: Ship the purple baseline scheme in a branded product
Code Bad: tailwind({ theme: "m3" }) // brand app left on #6750A4

Guideline: Disable the build-time seed for runtime colour
Description: seed: false leaves the --md-sys-color-* roles to applyDynamicColor, <m3-theme> or M3Html at runtime
Do: Use seed: false when colours come from user or wallpaper input
Don't: Generate a build-time scheme that runtime code immediately overwrites

Guideline: Import the CSS-first preset in order
Description: Without the Bun plugin the preset is four imports: Tailwind, static tokens, expressive tokens, then the m3-tailwind preset; no JS plugin or config file
Do: Import tailwindcss then m3-tokens.css expressive.css and preset.css
Don't: Recreate the preset in a tailwind.config file

Guideline: Style with colour roles not raw hex
Description: M3 colour roles keep light dark and dynamic schemes consistent; the preset exposes all 49 roles as utilities
Do: Use bg-primary text-on-surface border-outline-variant and var(--md-sys-color-*)
Don't: Hard-code hex values in components

Guideline: Pair every fill with its on-role
Description: Each M3 fill role has a matching on-role for text and icons that guarantees contrast in every scheme
Do: Use primary-container with on-primary-container and surface with on-surface
Don't: Put on-surface text on a primary fill or white text on any container

Guideline: Use surface container tiers for regions
Description: surface-container-lowest to surface-container-highest separate regions by tone instead of extra shadows or borders
Do: Pick a container tier for cards sheets and navigation
Don't: Stack shadows or grey borders to separate flat regions

Guideline: Keep colours in the token owner
Description: Colours come from crates/aphrody-m3-tokens through m3Css; inline --md-sys-color-* writes break the generated prefers-contrast blocks
Do: Regenerate sheets with m3 tokens or bun run generate
Don't: Write --md-sys-color-* inline from component code

Guideline: Lint colour role names
Description: A misspelled var(--md-sys-color-*) resolves to unset silently; the m3 lint plugin checks it against the roles material-web emits
Do: Enable m3/valid-color-role under bun lint jsPlugins
Don't: Ship unchecked role names

Guideline: Generate schemes from a source colour
Description: schemeFromSeed and cssFromSeed build every role from one seed with seven variants and a contrast level
Do: Derive light and dark from the same seed and variant
Don't: Hand-pick dark colours independently from light ones

Guideline: Apply and clear Material You at runtime
Description: applyDynamicColor writes the roles on a target and clearDynamicColor restores the build-time scheme
Do: Call clearDynamicColor when the user resets the colour
Don't: Leave stale inline roles after the preference is removed

Guideline: Use the M3 typescale utilities
Description: The preset provides 15 base and 15 emphasized type roles with size line height tracking and weight
Do: Use text-body-large text-title-small-emphasized or typescale-label-large
Don't: Set ad hoc font sizes and letter spacing per component

Guideline: Hand next/font variables to M3Root
Description: next/font needs literal arguments in the calling module, so load fonts in layout.tsx and point the M3 reference typefaces at the CSS variable
Do: Pass typefaces={{ brand, plain }} to M3Root
Don't: Expect a library to call next/font for you
Code Bad: import { fonts } from "@aphrody/m3-next" // next/font inside a package

Guideline: Use the M3 font sheets outside Next.js
Description: @aphrody/m3-fonts/fonts.css ships Google Sans Flex, Google Sans Code, Roboto Flex and Roboto Mono faces; Japanese and Symbols sheets are opt-in
Do: Import fonts.css and add fonts-jp.css only for Japanese content
Don't: Load every subset and the Symbols font on every page

Guideline: Use the corner radius scale
Description: M3 defines none through full corners (4 8 12 16 20 28 32 48 px and 9999px) as shape tokens and rounded utilities
Do: Use rounded-large or var(--md-sys-shape-corner-medium)
Don't: Invent radii per component

Guideline: Use directional shapes for edge-attached surfaces
Description: Expressive directional shapes round only the free edges and are RTL-aware
Do: Use shape-extra-large-top for bottom sheets and shape-large-start for start drawers
Don't: Hard-code left or right corner radii

Guideline: Use elevation levels 0 to 5
Description: Elevation shadows derive from --md-sys-color-shadow so they follow the scheme
Do: Use shadow-elevation-1 to shadow-elevation-5 sparingly
Don't: Mix custom drop shadows with M3 surfaces

Guideline: Use easing and duration tokens
Description: M3 easings (standard emphasized and their accelerate decelerate forms) and durations short1 to extra-long4 come as utilities
Do: Use ease-emphasized duration-medium2 or motion-default-effects
Don't: Use linear or arbitrary cubic-bezier timings

Guideline: Use sampled spring easings for spatial motion
Description: CSS has no spring easing; spring tokens are sampled into 33-stop linear() easings with a settle time and keep their bounce
Do: Use ease-spring-expressive-fast-spatial for position and size changes
Don't: Fake overshoot with a cubic-bezier

Guideline: Use the M3 transition patterns
Description: @aphrody/m3-motion implements container transform shared axis fade through collapse and fade on Motion
Do: Use M3ContainerTransform for card to detail navigation
Don't: Hand-roll cross-fades that skew content

Guideline: Honour reduced motion for springs and transforms
Description: Spatial springs and container transforms must collapse to an instant or fade change when the user asks for less motion
Do: Gate spatial motion behind motion-safe or useReducedMotion
Don't: Run bouncing spring transitions unconditionally

Guideline: Use state layers for interaction feedback
Description: state-layer utilities paint hover focus pressed and dragged overlays; focus and pressed stay at 0.10 like Compose
Do: Use state-layer or state-layer-primary on interactive surfaces
Don't: Darken colours per state with ad hoc hover classes

Guideline: Style Base UI state with the m3 variants
Description: The preset maps Base UI data attributes to m3-open m3-on m3-highlighted m3-disabled m3-invalid m3-enter and m3-exit variants
Do: Use m3-highlighted:bg-on-surface/8
Don't: Duplicate data-[highlighted] selectors in every component

Guideline: Keep a visible focus indicator
Description: A state layer alone is too subtle for keyboard users; pair it with an outline that survives forced colors
Do: Add a 2px focus-visible outline and a forced-colors outline
Don't: Remove the outline because the state layer shows focus

Guideline: Name every icon button
Description: Icon-only md icon buttons need an accessible name; m3/require-icon-button-label flags the missing ones
Do: Set aria-label on MdIconButton and md-*-icon-button
Don't: Rely on the glyph name as the accessible name

Guideline: Use window size classes
Description: Breakpoints follow M3 window classes 600 840 1200 and 1600 dp wide with compact medium expanded large and extra-large variants
Do: Use medium: expanded: large: variants or --md-breakpoint-* values
Don't: Mix Tailwind sm md lg breakpoints with M3 layouts
Code Bad: <nav class="hidden md:flex"> // 768px is not an M3 class

Guideline: Pick navigation from the platform state
Description: platformState(widthDp) returns the size class navigation kind (bar rail-collapsed rail-expanded) panes and margin
Do: Switch bar and rail from platformState
Don't: Hard-code a bottom bar for every width

Guideline: Use component size variants for density
Description: M3 Base UI components expose size steps instead of shrinking padding per screen
Do: Use M3Button size xs sm md lg or xl
Don't: Override padding to squeeze controls below the touch target

Guideline: Follow .dark or the OS unless .light
Description: The preset dark variant follows .dark or prefers-color-scheme unless .light forces light; the scheme sets color-scheme accordingly
Do: Toggle .dark or .light on html
Don't: Add a separate dark palette that ignores the OS

Guideline: Render the themed shell first
Description: M3Root writes the mode class color-scheme and inline roles into html; readCookie false keeps the shell static and a pre-paint script applies the saved mode
Do: Use <M3Root readCookie={false}> with Cache Components or static export
Don't: Read the theme cookie in the root layout of a static app
Code Bad: const mode = (await cookies()).get("m3-theme") // in a static root layout

Guideline: Use the Base UI wrappers for React
Description: @aphrody/m3-baseui wraps 38 Base UI primitives with M3 classes and no CSS-in-JS
Do: Use M3Button M3Dialog M3Select M3Switch
Don't: Restyle raw Base UI primitives in every app

Guideline: Compose wrappers through render
Description: Base UI composition uses the render prop so a trigger keeps one element and its semantics
Do: Pass render={<M3Button />} to triggers and closes
Don't: Nest a button inside a trigger button

Guideline: Import only the component sheets you use
Description: m3-baseui ships core.css plus one sheet per component; m3-baseui.css loads them all
Do: Import core.css and the sheets of rendered components
Don't: Import every sheet in a small static export

Guideline: Use typed md-* wrappers in React
Description: @aphrody/m3-react wraps all 119 md-* elements with createComponent; importing a wrapper registers its element and native events read e.target
Do: Read values from e.target in onInput and onChange
Don't: Expect the MUI (event, value) callback signature

Guideline: Load Material Symbols before MdIcon
Description: MdIcon renders a Material Symbols glyph name and does not load the font itself
Do: Call ensureMaterialSymbols once at start-up, optionally with iconNames
Don't: Render MdIcon without the font or with PascalCase MUI names

Guideline: Use build-time SVG icons in client bundles
Description: The @aphrody/m3-icons root entry loads the native Bun library; browsers use ./browser with SVG generated by codegen the plugin or the server
Do: Import m3:icon/<style>/<name> and render M3IconSvg
Don't: Import the root entry from a client component

Guideline: Drive icon axes with tokens
Description: Material Symbols fill weight grade and optical size are variable axes exposed as --md-icon-* tokens
Do: Set --md-icon-fill and --md-icon-wght
Don't: Write fontVariationSettings inline on each icon

Guideline: Wrap next.config with withM3
Description: withM3 transpiles the M3 packages keeps @aphrody/bun external rewrites barrel imports and never overrides a key the config sets
Do: Export withM3(config, { reactCompiler, cacheComponents, typedRoutes })
Don't: List every M3 package in transpilePackages by hand
Code Good: export default withM3({}, { reactCompiler: true, cacheComponents: true })

Guideline: Import the M3 sheet after Tailwind
Description: @aphrody/m3-next/m3.css bundles tokens expressive tokens colour roles and the Tailwind preset
Do: Import tailwindcss then @aphrody/m3-next/m3.css in app/globals.css
Don't: Import M3 sheets before tailwindcss

Guideline: Guarantee the theme cookie in proxy.ts
Description: createM3Proxy makes every page request carry a valid m3-theme cookie; the matcher must be a literal
Do: Export proxy = createM3Proxy() with a literal pages-only matcher
Don't: Build the matcher dynamically or name a package helper proxy.ts
Code Good: export const proxy = createM3Proxy(); export const config = { matcher: ["/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|.*\\..*).*)"] };
Code Bad: export const config = { matcher: routes.map(r => r.path) };

Guideline: Run Next on Bun without Node
Description: m3-next and next-bun put a Bun node first on PATH so Turbopack workers also run on Bun
Do: Use m3-next dev build and start
Don't: Run bun --bun next build and let Turbopack spawn node

Guideline: Export statically for Tauri
Description: withM3(config, { tauri: true }) sets output export unoptimized images trailing slashes and disables Cache Components
Do: Use tauri: true or auto and point frontendDist at ../out
Don't: Rely on proxy.ts or server cookies in a static export
Code Bad: export const proxy = createM3Proxy() // static export

Guideline: Bridge shadcn aliases to M3 roles
Description: @aphrody/m3-theme/tokens.css maps --background --primary --border and the Tailwind @theme aliases onto --md-sys-color-*; dark re-declares only the M3 palette
Do: Import tokens.css once and style with either vocabulary
Don't: Maintain separate shadcn and M3 palettes
